entities.name: CoaBC
observations: 399-aa query matches reviewed CoaBC homologs at about 45% identity and 98.5% query coverage; function is inferred by homology.
Bifunctional CoA-biosynthesis enzyme with phosphopantothenate–cysteine ligase (EC 6.3.2.5) and phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylase (EC 4.1.1.36) activities.
Homolog annotations report FMN and Mg2+; these cofactors are not experimentally confirmed for the query sequence.

entities.name: CoaBC ligase reaction
observations: (R)-4'-phosphopantothenate + L-cysteine + CTP → N-[(R)-4-phosphopantothenoyl]-L-cysteine + CMP + diphosphate + H+; Rhea RHEA:19397.
